positions.description:

➤  Provide instruction to incoming consultants and organizations which contract for training with Manifest Solutions on various technologies:
 -  regular expressions
 -  version control, specifically with Git

positions.title: Student Intern
positions.description:
➤  Completed a comprehensive and intensive six-week course in Agile software development, led by Java Champion Chris Judd
➤  Covered enterprise development tools including Eclipse, Maven, Subversion, and Jenkins
➤  Contributed to an ongoing product for resource management - technologies used include Spring, Spring Security, Struts2, Tiles, HTML, JavaScript, CSS, and Cucumber/Ruby
➤  Learned within the context of the Agile methodology - weekly iterations, started each day with a stand-up meeting, tracked progress via big visuals, worked with rotating partners for paired programming, received code reviews, ended iterations with retrospectives, and practiced Test-Driven Development (TDD) with tools such as JUnit and EasyMock
➤  Conducted extensive data analysis on MySQL and PostgreSQL databases including examination of query plans on the open content, multi-gigabyte Musicbrainz database
➤  Developed highly expressive acceptance tests with Gherkin, Cucumber, and the Watir and Page Object libraries in Ruby

positions.title: Application Developer (via Manifest Solutions)
positions.description:
➤  Migrated our team from Microsoft SQL Server to PostgreSQL
 -  Analyzed all domains in Grails 2.3.11 application to ensure schemas were properly generated in new database
 -  Performed ETL of data in production system via Talend Open Studio for Data Integration
➤  Introduced client-side behavior testing with Jasmine
 -  Reduced total time needed for test runs by moving tests from functional, browser-driven test suite, requiring an instance of the application, to lightweight front-end test suite
 -  Increased velocity of developers by enabling the writing of simple tests against client-side logic instead of functional tests against the full application
➤  Developed the minimum viable product for a new application integrating several previously separate applications
➤  Rewrote a vendor-hosted application for requesting additional access rights in another vendor’s system into an in-house application
 -  Designed domain objects, controllers, and services in Grails 2.3.11
 -  Implemented user interface via GSPs, AJAX, Bootstrap, and jQuery
➤  Introduced automated functional testing using Geb
 -  Improved agility of development process by engaging stakeholders to write concise requirements for features
 -  Reduced unnecessary & repetitive feedback loops between developers and stakeholders by improving precision of initial specifications
 -  Reduced amount of manual testing performed on system after every feature deployment, giving time back to developers to continue feature development
 -  Provided assurance to product stakeholders that systems continued to work as designed
➤  Contributed to rewrite of legacy system which runs lottery for students to attend alternative schools
 -   Using Grails 2.3.11, wrote new controller actions and service methods to interact with existing domains
 -  Implemented the administrative interface to the new system via GSPs, AJAX, Bootstrap, and jQuery

positions.title: Automated Test Developer (via Manifest Solutions)
positions.description:
➤  Engaged with requirements analysts and application developers to define technical specifications and implementation details of enhancements undergoing development
➤  Performed analysis of Oracle databases and translated data requirements into executable queries
➤  Developed acceptance tests in Gherkin and Ruby for enhancements to web applications
➤  Conducted manual testing of web applications across modern desktop browsers and mobile devices
➤  Conducted regular code reviews with other members of automation testing team

positions.title: Technical Support Team
positions.description:
➤  Worked closely with clients to create and administer user accounts through web interfaces and direct database access
➤  Corresponded with client end users and administrators in order to solve technical problems
➤  Debugged existing code and communicate problems to development team
➤  Conducted two-tiered testing of the learning management system and individual courses within the learning environment
➤  Edited, proofread, and assisted in creation of SCORM courses for learning management systems
➤  Created documentation of systems for use by support staff and client administrators

positions.title: Implementation Manager
positions.description:
➤  Tracked progress of enhancements to software
➤  Participated in weekly conference calls to discuss status of scheduled enhancements and scope requirements for new enhancements
➤  Provided Tier 2 technical support.
